items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBdll1IiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--f25f27c6c1e59408489900ec630435f0e454a90c/logo%20izcube%20a.jpg) Nos sentimos muy emocionados de presentar IZCUBE 2023. ¡El torneo más grande de México! Esta ocasión, gracias al Gobierno Municipal de Cuautitlán Izcalli a través del Instituto Municipal de la Juventud, regresamos a este municipio tan representativo del Estado de México. Con tu asistencia esperamos ser el torneo con mayor número participantes del país hasta ahora. Ayúdanos a lograrlo y súmate a esta gran experiencia. IZCUBE 2023 es una competencia oficial de la WCA por lo que todos los competidores deben estar familiarizados con el [Reglamento](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/spanish-american/). Te esperamos en Cuautitlán Izcalli; *Tu Casa Entre los Árboles*. _____________________________________________ We feel very excited to present IZCUBE 2023. The biggest competition of Mexico! This time, thanks to the Municipal Government of Cuautitlan Izcalli through the Municipal Institute of Youth, we are back to this representative city of the State of Mexico. With your attendance, we hope to see the most number of participants ever in the country by now. Help us to achieve it and be a part of this great endeavour. IZCUBE 2023 is a WCA official competition, hence all participants should be familiar with the [Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/). We are waiting for you in Cuautitlan Izcalli; *Your Home Between Trees*.

items.name: Michigan Mini 2 2023
items.information: THIS COMPETITION TAKES PLACE ON FRIDAY NIGHT! We recognize that not everyone will be able to arrive at 6PM. Please indicate your expected arrival time in your registration comments. We will create groups based on this information and hope to allow everyone arriving before 7:30 to compete in all the events. Please do your best to arrive as early as reasonably possible for you. If we feel like too many people are showing up as late as they possibly can, we will need to reconsider the format of these competitions in the future. Free parking is available on site

items.name: Washington Championship 2023
items.information: This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association competition. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/). If you are new to competing, please refer to the [Competitor Responsibilities](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/WashingtonChampionships2023#21732-competitor-responsibilities) tab. Join our [Facebook group](https://www.facebook.com/groups/159856602085) to hear about competitions in the Pacific Northwest before they're announced and keep in touch with cubers in the area!
